statement: CISA adds at least one Ivanti Connect Secure CVE, other than CVE-2026-118527 and CVE-2026-111357, to the KEV catalog between 2026-10-31 and 2026-12-31, consistent with the reported three-flaw exploit chain.
resolution: CISA KEV catalog carries an Ivanti Connect Secure entry, excluding CVE-2026-118527 and CVE-2026-111357, with dateAdded between 2026-10-31 and 2026-12-31 inclusive.
failure_condition: No Ivanti Connect Secure CVE other than the two named has a KEV dateAdded value between 2026-10-31 and 2026-12-31.

statement: Democratic candidates win at least 218 US House seats in the general election held on 2026-11-03.
resolution: AP race calls, as published by the deadline, credit Democratic candidates with 218 or more House seats from the 2026-11-03 general election.
failure_condition: Democratic candidates hold fewer than 218 AP-called House seats from the 2026-11-03 election at the deadline.

statement: Democrats and Democratic-caucusing independents win at least 51 US Senate seats as a result of the general election held on 2026-11-03.
resolution: AP race calls by the deadline produce a Senate composition for the next Congress with 51 or more Democrats plus Democratic-caucusing independents.
failure_condition: The AP-called Senate composition for the next Congress gives Democrats plus caucusing independents 50 or fewer seats at the deadline.

statement: WTI crude spot price on 2026-12-31 is below 100.00 USD per barrel. Reference: 104.12 USD on the packet date 2026-10-31.
resolution: FRED series DCOILWTICO value for 2026-12-31 is below 100.00. Reference: 104.12 on 2026-10-31.
failure_condition: The FRED DCOILWTICO value for 2026-12-31 is 100.00 or higher.

statement: The US 10-year Treasury constant maturity yield on 2026-12-31 is above 5.00 percent. Reference: 4.93 percent on the packet date 2026-10-31.
resolution: FRED series DGS10 value for 2026-12-31 exceeds 5.00. Reference: 4.93 percent on 2026-10-31.
failure_condition: The FRED DGS10 value for 2026-12-31 is 5.00 or lower.

statement: US and Iranian government officials hold direct, face-to-face talks between 2026-11-01 and 2026-12-31, following Qatari mediation efforts.
resolution: Reuters or AP reports, with confirmation by both the US State Department and the Iranian Foreign Ministry, a direct in-person US-Iran meeting occurring between 2026-11-01 and 2026-12-31.
failure_condition: No in-person meeting between US and Iranian officials occurs between 2026-11-01 and 2026-12-31 that both governments confirm.

statement: Iran formally submits notice of withdrawal from the NPT under Article X between 2026-11-01 and 2027-03-31.
resolution: The UN Security Council or depositary governments receive a formal Iranian Article X withdrawal notice dated between 2026-11-01 and 2027-03-31, per UN records or Reuters/AP.
failure_condition: Iran has not delivered a formal Article X NPT withdrawal notice dated between 2026-11-01 and 2027-03-31.

statement: Iranian forces seize or detain a commercial tanker in the Strait of Hormuz or Gulf of Oman between 2026-11-01 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: Reuters and AP each report Iranian forces (IRGC or navy) seized or detained a commercial tanker in the Strait of Hormuz or Gulf of Oman between 2026-11-01 and 2026-12-31.
failure_condition: No commercial tanker is seized or detained by Iranian forces in the Strait of Hormuz or Gulf of Oman between 2026-11-01 and 2026-12-31.

statement: WHO declares the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo over between 2026-11-01 and 2027-04-15.
resolution: WHO Disease Outbreak News or an official WHO statement declares the end of the current DRC Ebola outbreak, with the declaration dated between 2026-11-01 and 2027-04-15.
failure_condition: The DRC Ebola outbreak has not been declared over by WHO between 2026-11-01 and 2027-04-15.

statement: The FBI publicly attributes the reported 6.3 billion USD Binance hack to North Korean actors between 2026-10-31 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: An FBI press release or IC3 public service announcement dated between 2026-10-31 and 2026-12-31 attributes the Binance hack to North Korea or a DPRK-linked group.
failure_condition: The FBI has not attributed the Binance hack to North Korea or a DPRK-linked group in a statement dated between 2026-10-31 and 2026-12-31.
